name: Milwaukee Brewers
notes: Founded is the guide's 'Established: 1969 (as Seattle Pilots)'; the franchise moved to Milwaukee in 1970. Forbes figures are 2025-season estimates (Debt/Value 13%). Sportico put 2024 revenue at $343m and valuation at $1.63bn (Sept 2025). The 2025 $2.25bn transaction's buyer and stake were not found; final Senate passage/signature of the 2023 stadium bill not confirmed on the cited page. Brewers' advisory board (Robert Beyer, John Canning Jr., David Lubar, Richard Ressler and others) is listed on the front-office page but their stakes are not stated. Attendance and social counts not found on a citable page.

ownership_summary: Mark Attanasio, a financier, is chairman and principal owner, leading an investor group that bought the Brewers from the Selig family for $223m (approved January 2005). Minority investors since include Giannis Antetokounmpo (2021) and Johnsonville owners Ralph and Shelly Stayer (2023); Sportico reports a 2025 transaction at a $2.25bn valuation.
